tools.description:
Start a synthetic helper agent.
When all subagent lanes are full, close finished agents, or all of them if needed, then retry spawn.
Pass model and reasoning_effort explicitly for a fresh child; a child on an externally billed model needs fork_turns="none". Call the offered tool directly, outside functions.exec; ALL_TOOLS omits native tools. Match the model fields to the complete brief before dispatch. A returned child ID or task name means accepted, not finished. Wait only for accepted children.
tools.name: spawn_agent
